text: The street light outside my house in sector 4 has been broken for 2 months.
Pani nahi aa raha hai pichle 3 din se, please help.

Hospital me doctors available nahi rehte raat me, bahut problem hoti hai.
Road is completely broken after the rains. Potholes everywhere.
Bijli ka bill bahut zyada aaya hai is mahine, check kijiye.
No water supply in our locality since yesterday morning.
Kachra gaadi 4 din se nahi aayi hai hamare area me.
There are no medicines available at the local government dispensary.
Trafic light at the main junction is not working, causing massive jams.
Transformer jal gaya hai kal raat se, current nahi hai.
The drinking water coming from the tap is yellow and smells foul.
Naali jaam ho gayi hai aur paani raste par beh raha hai.

Toll plaza par fastag theek se scan nahi ho raha hai.
Frequent power cuts in our area for the last one week.
Paani ka pressure bilkul nahi hai tap me.
Public toilets are not being cleaned regularly.

Gaddhe bharne ka kaam aadha chhod diya gaya hai.

Pipeline leak kar rahi hai aur paani waste ho raha hai.
Dead animal lying on the street for two days, please remove it.

Road construction material blocking the footpath.

Highway par accident ke baad road clear nahi hui hai.
